## What's new

Threadnote 5.2.0-beta.3 keeps local installations focused on the commands they need and installs organization credential helpers only when configured.

- Local installations create just `threadnote` and `threadnote-mcp-server` by default.
- Organization credential helpers follow the configured organization features, including legacy aliases required by existing setups.
- Doctor, repair, and updates use the same launcher requirements so unnecessary helpers stay removed.

[Full changelog since 5.2.0-beta.2](https://github.com/threadnote/threadnote/compare/v5.2.0-beta.2...v5.2.0-beta.3)
